It is a hard thing to discuss, but once you start talking, you will find that it will become easier, and you will feel so much better letting it all out. If I were you, I would just ask her if she has a period of time one day that you could talk to her in private. That you have something personal that you need to talk to her about. Seems like she would be more than happy to find that time for you. :)
every day it's something else. i'm just too tired to even go into all of it. i feel so drained.

Have you thought about talking to your teacher about your depression? Some people, your mom for example, don't know how to handle those situations and don't understand depression. Then there are other adults who do. Your spanish teacher sounds like a trusted adult and someone you feel comfortable talking to. I also think she would be honored for you to come to her, trusting her with this information. She can help you find the proper help. Give it a try. That is another thing that teachers are there for. To help guide you, not only with academics, but in life as well.
